vLLM local provider routes requests via vllm/ model prefix with no auth

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'vllm/meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B'))
puts result.inspect
```
